content:
camila: Heads-up — small agenda flip. We'll run the lightning demos first (10m each), then do the leadership Q&A. Reason: a couple of demo teams need their windows and infra wants shorter continuous encoder load. ok with everyone? :wave:
kevin: ok from stage ops. will prep mics and cue cards.
ben: infra ok but want to reduce OBS scene transitions during demos. low-impact plan: single camera wide shot for demos, switch to multi-cam for Q&A.
oliver: streamer host on floor2 showing elevated GPU temp on the capture box, trending 78C. can still run but prefer fewer scene changes.
sara: AV: we can hard-pin the camera to "wide" scene and pre-roll the demo clips to reduce live switching. also enabling hardware accel for ffmpeg.
camila: great. kevin, ping demo leads to cut to pre-recorded clip if their live demos are fragile.
maya: I'll notify leadership about order change and update the Q&A doc. please surface any roadmap questions in the doc so we can queue them.
ben: encoder watch: I'm going to engage backup streamer if CPU > 90% or if ffmpeg restarts. fallback command ready:
```
# fallback to simple x11grab -> backup RTMP
ffmpeg -re -f x11grab -s 1280x720 -i :0.0 -r 25 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -b:v 2500k -f flv rtmp://backup.stream/redwood_key
```
ben: also starting a local ISO recording to /var/recordings/allhands-2025-11-04-iso.mkv for redundancy. uploading to s3 post-meeting.
kevin: stage tech note: bringing static mic set for demos to avoid re-plugging lavs. will mute house speakers during demos to prevent bleed.
oliver: captions team — are we green? last time captions failed for Q&A.
sara: enabling live transcribe v3 with audio-surge protection. expected lag ~4s but accuracy better. also routing captions to both stream and local iso.
camila: excellent. small ask: if we get any recording gaps, file a follow-up ticket with the timestamp and me + @maya in the thread. we'll triage post-meeting.
allhands-bot: [REMINDER] Panelists: join stage-A mic check in 6 minutes. Stream goes live at 2025-11-04T17:05:00Z.
ben: done provisioning local iso recorder. path: /var/recordings/allhands-2025-11-04-iso.mkv. starting now.
kevin: demo leads — please post your final slide deck links here if you want them clipped and stitched in post.
maya: shared Q&A doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/allhands/qna-20251104 — please add questions and mark urgent ones with [URGENT].
camila: thanks everyone. we'll start in 8. if anyone sees degrading stream metrics, @ben and @oliver handle the swap.
ben: will monitor and call swap if needed. :ok_hand:
(End of thread)
